title: Model Switcher Integration & Superconductor–Caduceus Symbiosis
description: Wires the model_selector_20260721 components into the live Superconductor engine, establishes bi-directional Superconductor–Caduceus awareness (pre_invoke detection, context injection, model default overrides, adaptive routing), implements an async component staging registry bridge, and adds a real-time AgentTurnEvent bus for history-driven automatic model routing.
